summary: FinLingo Phase 2 testing — backend pytest (21/21 PASS) covering admin jobs/PDFs, admin-only auth (403), AI-generated course /full nested fetch, revisions SM-2 (grade=2 → +5 XP & interval up, grade=0 → resets to 1, unknown concept → 404), boss-battles shape/locked/unlocked/submit (passing=50XP + boss_slayer, failing=10XP), Phase 1 regressions (health, auth/me, leaderboard, stats). Frontend Playwright: admin login → nav-admin visible (after settle) → /admin AI Lab loads with pdf-uploader, 1 PDF (loma.pdf 70MB), 2 generation jobs including LOMA 281 v2 status 'Done'. Demo user does NOT see nav-admin, sees nav-revise, header chips (xp/coins/streak) render. Revise page loads with mascot empty-state ('Nothing due yet') for demo. Dashboard shows AI-generated 'LOMA 281 v2' course alongside seeded. /learn/<ai-course> renders 13 concept-node cards and two boss-cta buttons in disabled state because the chapter isn't complete. Direct nav to /boss/<chapter_id> shows 'Boss locked' lock screen with '1/7 mastered' messaging. Phase 1 regression flows verified working in prior iteration.

ui_bugs.issue: Immediately after admin login redirect, `[data-testid="nav-admin"]` count was 0 on first probe; navigating away and back made it appear. AuthContext likely settles the role asynchronously, so the AppShell renders once with stale/no user before the role-gated link mounts. Not a functional blocker (link works once user object hydrates), but causes a perceptible flash where admin nav is missing.

Spec mentions `revise-cta` and `revision-done` testids; empty 'Nothing due yet' card has no testid attribute. Only `revision-card` (which is not rendered in empty state) is documented. Adding `data-testid="revision-empty"` (or `revision-done`) would make tests deterministic.

issues: Spec asks for full-page zinc-950 dark mode background. Only the inner BossBattle card area is dark; the surrounding page chrome (body + AppShell header area) remains light (rgb(250,250,250)). Consider applying `bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-100` on the root wrapper (or `<body>` via effect) so the whole route is dark, not just the card.

action_items: Optional polish: apply dark-mode (`bg-zinc-950`) to the whole BossBattle page wrapper, not just the inner card, to match spec.
Optional polish: gate nav-admin render on `auth-loaded` state so it doesn't flash absent right after login.
Optional polish: add `data-testid="revision-empty"` to the Revise empty-state card for cleaner E2E selectors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~850 lines. Phase 2 added admin/revisions/boss-battles inline — consider splitting into routers/admin.py, routers/revisions.py, routers/boss.py.

`_run_generation_job` uses module-level `logger` defined at the bottom of the file; if a generation runs before module logger is initialized it would NameError. Today it's fine because logger is set during import, but moving it to top would be safer.

/api/boss-battles/{chapter_id} samples MCQs with `random.sample` on every call — score depends on which 8 questions were sampled but the submit endpoint trusts client-supplied correct_count/total. That means a malicious client can POST {correct_count:10,total:10} for any chapter and unlock boss_slayer + 50 XP without ever answering. Recommend server-side scoring: send question ids+correct answers map and validate or accept answer payload and grade on server.

Course/{id}/full unlock logic mutates `concept['progress']['status']` in place — fine, but doc this — the persisted progress doc still says 'active' while server-side returned 'locked' which can drift if cached on the client.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (11/12 spec-tested flows; one minor flake on nav-admin first probe; dark-mode partial)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests POSTed /progress/complete-concept and /boss-battles/submit on the demo user, awarding XP and unlocking the boss_slayer achievement. No fresh users were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 2 backend endpoints are real and behave per spec. Boss battle scoring is client-trusted — flag if hardening is in scope. The AI-generated course id 36fa5852-7597-46e1-8f55-5054486721b3 already exists with 2 chapters, 13 concepts, real MCQ lessons; do not regenerate (expensive). Demo user now has boss_slayer achievement + extra XP (~110) from test runs; if testing 'no achievements yet', use a fresh signup.

issue_1_nav_admin_flash.description: Brief absence of nav-admin link right after admin login.
issue_1_nav_admin_flash.likely_cause: AppShell renders before AuthContext finishes the post-login state update; `user?.role === 'admin'` is false in the first paint. Once the context settles (next render) the link appears.
issue_1_nav_admin_flash.mitigation: Show a small loader / hold render until `user` is non-null after a successful login transition, or persist last-known role from localStorage and hydrate immediately.

issue_2_boss_dark_mode_partial.description: Boss Battle page only applies dark bg to inner card; page chrome stays light.
issue_2_boss_dark_mode_partial.likely_cause: BossBattle component sets `bg-zinc-950` on its container div instead of wrapping the route (or applying via body effect).
issue_2_boss_dark_mode_partial.mitigation:
In BossBattle.jsx wrap with `
…
` at the outermost return, or `useEffect(() => { document.body.classList.add('bg-zinc-950'); return () => document.body.classList.remove('bg-zinc-950'); }, [])`.
